summary: Hunter with a lower leg injury unable to hike out in the Flat Tops Wilderness near Stillwater Reservoir; RCSAR mutual-aid response — hiked in, stabilized and packaged the patient in a wheeled stokes litter, transported to a private vehicle at the trailhead
location: Flat Tops Wilderness near Stillwater Reservoir
responding_agency: Routt County Search and Rescue (mutual aid)
notes: RCSAR Far Routt Newsletter Fall Edition Nov-2024 (parent-opened); "Injured Hunter in the Flat Tops Wilderness"; Garfield County, RCSAR assists due to faster response than GCSAR
